Crunchbase, HN Algolia, Bing and DuckDuckGo searches for press coverage of a seed/pre-seed round or revenue turned up nothing specific to this company (name collides heavily with the unrelated open-source 'OpenSteer' boids/steering-behavior C++ library, which pollutes search results). Treat funding stage, amount and revenue as unknown pending better sources; only the YC S23 accelerator relationship and independent-startup ownership are confirmed.
